description: This file defines API endpoints for handling contact messages, including submitting new messages, listing messages with pagination for admins, and updating message status. It uses FastAPI for routing and SQLAlchemy for database operations.

classes.description: ORM model representing a contact message entity in the database.

classes.description: Generic response schema for paginated data.

classes.description: Schema for outputting contact message data.

classes.description: Schema for creating a new contact message.

classes.name: ContactMessageUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating contact message status.

methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a paginated list of contact messages, restricted to admins.
